Alperen Sengun (23 points, 11 rebounds, 11 assists) recorded a triple-double to propel the Rockets to a 116-104 victory tonight in Houston. Devin Booker finished with a team-high 25 points along with 5 assists and 2 three pointers in the losing effort. The Rockets improve their record to 14-5 with the win, while the Suns fall to 9-8 for the season.
